title: OfficeGo {{version}}
subtitle: Microsoft Office installer for Windows 10 and 11

noStart.question: The installation does not start
noStart.answer: Check that OfficeGo was opened with administrator permissions. Without them Windows lets nothing install: use the «Restart with permissions» button.

downloadFails.question: The download fails right away
downloadFails.answer: An outdated Windows uses an old security protocol. OfficeGo turns on TLS 1.2, so this only happens on very outdated computers.

antivirus.question: The antivirus blocks activation
antivirus.answer: Defender flags every activation tool by design. Pause real-time protection, activate, and turn it back on.

frozen.question: It looks frozen while installing
frozen.answer: The bar may sit still for minutes while Microsoft unpacks. If the time below keeps going, it is working.

offlineInstall.question: How do I use the offline installer
offlineInstall.answer: Copy the whole folder to the other computer and open instalar.cmd. Windows asks for permissions and Office installs from those files, without internet.
